About me

A little about me.

“ఇలాగే కడదాకా ఓ ప్రశ్నై ఉంటానంటున్నా.”I hope to remain a question, right until the very end.
Life of Ram, Jaanu

I’ve always liked the idea of never quite running out of questions. Perhaps that’s why I’ve found myself drawn to understanding how things work, what drives decisions and what makes people and ideas interesting.

I’m currently pursuing a BBA (Hons) at TAPMI, Bengaluru, with interests in business, economics and management. From leading the organising committee for my school’s first MUN and heading the Music Club to getting involved with ARC and E-Cell at TAPMI, I’ve enjoyed opportunities that involve taking initiative, working with people and bringing ideas to life.

I’m still exploring where these interests will take me, but I know I want to keep learning, getting involved and asking questions along the way.
